articles.summary: 🌍 We’re proud to highlight that Tyrolpath, the largest private pathology lab in western Austria, is the first lab in Austria to adopt MSK-IMPACT®-Flex powered with SOPHiA DDM™, marking a major milestone for precision oncology in the country.
